    {α β σ κ : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β]
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [Nonempty σ]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (ψ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SubMeas α ι) (B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SubMeas β ι) (eval : σ → α → κ) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution σ)
        (fun s => ∑ k : κ, ∑ b : β,
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψ
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι)
                (B.outcome b * (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.postprocess A (eval s)).outcome k * B.outcome b) *
              _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.postprocess A (eval s)).outcome k))) =
      (∑ a : α, ∑ b : β,
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψ
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (B.outcome b * A.outcome a * B.outcome b) *
              _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (A.outcome a))) +
        ∑ aa : α × α, ∑ b : β,
          (if aa.1 = aa.2 then 0 else
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution σ)
              (fun s => if eval s aa.1 = eval s aa.2 then (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) else 0)) *
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψ
              (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (B.outcome b * A.outcome aa.1 * B.outcome b) *
                _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (A.outcome aa.2)) := by sorry

# Full-slice scalar-to-tensor closeness comparison

`closenessOfIP` comparisons transform scalar quartic averages into manifestly
positive tensor-form partners.  The same route includes tensor-marginalization
identities connecting full-slice and evaluated-slice `ABAB` averages.

The core `closenessOfIP` scalar↔tensor comparison lemmas are factored into
`ClosenessCore.lean` (extracted per #1127).

The tensor-form lemmas are internal to the scalar/tensor comparison recorded in
`docs/decisions/713-scalar-tensor-decision.md`; downstream code should use the
scalar public API exposed by the full-slice transport theorems.

# Section 6 — Averaged Slice Error Bounds: Core Estimates

This module contains the Jensen and averaging estimates for ordinary and
answer-valued restricted slice errors.
-/

theorems.theorem_title: Average Answer Successor Slice Self Improvement Error Le

theorems.formal_statement:
lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.average_answerSuccessorSliceMainInductionNu_le
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (profile : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerSuccessorRestrictedFailureProfile params strategy)
    (haxis :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedAxisParallelError params profile ≤
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * eps)
    (hself :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedSelfConsistencyError params profile ≤ delta)
    (hdiag :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedDiagonalError params profile ≤
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * gamma) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
        (fun x =>
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params k
            (profile.axisParallel x)
            (profile.selfConsistency x)
            (profile.diagonal x)) ≤
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Answer-valued successor analogue of the averaged recursive induction
parameter estimate.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

# Section 6 — Averaged Slice Error Bounds: Core Estimates

This module contains the Jensen and averaging estimates for ordinary and
answer-valued restricted slice errors.
-/

@[expose] public section

theorems.theorem_title: Average Answer Successor Slice Main Induction Nu Le

theorems.formal_statement:
lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.average_answerSuccessorSliceMainInductionError_le
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (profile : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerSuccessorRestrictedFailureProfile params strategy)
    (haxis :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedAxisParallelError params profile ≤
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * eps)
    (hself :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedSelfConsistencyError params profile ≤ delta)
    (hdiag :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedDiagonalError params profile ≤
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * gamma) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
        (fun x =>
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params k
            (profile.axisParallel x)
            (profile.selfConsistency x)
            (profile.diagonal x)) ≤
      ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)) *
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma +
          Real.exp (-((k : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / (80000 * ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)))))) := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Average of the recursive main-induction errors for answer-valued successor
slices.

/-!
# Section 6 — Averaged Slice Error Bounds: Successor Outputs

This module packages recursive answer-valued slice measurements and the final
self-improvement-to-main-induction error comparisons.
-/

@[expose] public section

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep

open MIPStarRE.LDT
open scoped MatrixOrder

universe uι uF

variable {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
theorems.theorem_title: Answer Self Improvement In Induction Error Le Main Induction Nu

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.throughPoint_eq_zeroPoint_of_m_eq_one
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (hm1 : params.m = 1)
    (u : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params) (i : Fin params.m) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine.throughPoint (params := params) u i =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine.throughPoint (params := params) _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.zeroPoint i := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
At m = 1, AxisParallelLine.throughPoint u i does not depend on the
base point u: all axis-parallel lines in direction i are geometrically the
unique line and share the same canonical representative.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

theorems.formal_statement:
lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answer_family_pointConsistencyError_eq_avg
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.bipartiteConsError strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.evaluatedAtNextPoint family) =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
        (fun x =>
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.bipartiteConsError strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas
              (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStratOfAnswer params strategy x).pointMeasurement)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params (family.meas x).toSubMeas)) := by sorry

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

lemmas used by the answer-valued successor route.

theorems.theorem_title: Answer Family Point Consistency Error Eq Avg

theorems.formal_statement:
lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answer_family_consistency_of_slice_bounds
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (sliceError : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (zeta : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hpoint :
      ∀ x,
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStratOfAnswer params strategy x).pointMeasurement)
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params (family.meas x).toSubMeas)
          (sliceError x))
    (havg : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params)) sliceError ≤ zeta) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.evaluatedAtNextPoint family)
      zeta := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Average slice-wise point consistency for an answer-valued successor strategy.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answer_family_consistency_of_slice_bounds`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

theorems.theorem_title: Answer Family Consistency Of Slice Bounds

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerLdPastingInInductionError_le_mainInductionError_of_smallError
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma kappa : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hsmall : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma < 1)
    (hkappa_le :
      kappa ≤
        ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)) *
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma +
              Real.exp (-((k : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / (80000 * ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ))))))
          + _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma)
    (hzeta_le_nu :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma ≤
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.ldPastingInInductionError params k eps delta gamma kappa
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma) ≤
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Scalar absorption for the answer-valued pasting route.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerLdPastingInInductionError_le_mainInductionError_of_smallError`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

/-! ### Answer-valued successor restrictions

The preceding lemmas start from an ordinary successor strategy and build the
answer-valued slice profile used in the current Section 6 successor route.  For
the simultaneous answer-valued induction theorem, the successor strategy itself
has answer-valued diagonal measurements.  The next definitions and lemmas
record the corresponding restricted-probability theorem without replacing that
diagonal measurement by an ordinary low-degree realization.

theorems.theorem_title: Answer Successor Self Consistency Restricted Average Eq

theorems.formal_statement:
lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.weighted_embedded_average_le_full_average
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    (f : Fin params.next.m → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceTransverseDirectionWeight params *
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin params.m)) (fun i => f (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.embedCoord params i)) ≤
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin params.next.m)) f := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
The weighted average over embedded transverse directions is bounded by the
ambient average over all directions.

/-! ### Answer-valued successor restrictions

The preceding lemmas start from an ordinary successor strategy and build the
answer-valued slice profile used in the current Section 6 successor route.  For
the simultaneous answer-valued induction theorem, the successor strategy itself
has answer-valued diagonal measurements.  The next definitions and lemmas
record the corresponding restricted-probability theorem without replacing that
diagonal measurement by an ordinary low-degree realization.
-/

    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)

    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)

    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
        (fun x => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceTransverseDirectionWeight params *
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedStrategy params strategy x).axisParallelFailureProbability) ≤ eps := by sorry

The weighted average of the restricted axis-parallel slice errors is bounded
by the ambient axis-parallel test error.

# Section 6 -- Answer-Valued Restricted Probability Statement

This module contains the answer-valued form of the restricted-probability
bookkeeping for the main induction step.

## References

- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch10_induction.tex`
-/

theorems.theorem_title: Answer Weighted Axis Parallel Bound

theorems.formal_statement:
lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessor_weighted_axisParallel_bound
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
        (fun x => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceTransverseDirectionWeight params *
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStratOfAnswer params strategy x).axisParallelFailureProbability)
      ≤ eps := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
The weighted average of the answer-valued successor restricted
axis-parallel slice errors is bounded by the ambient answer-valued
axis-parallel test error.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessor_weighted_axisParallel_bound`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

# Section 6 -- Answer-Valued Restricted Probability Statement

This module contains the answer-valued form of the restricted-probability
bookkeeping for the main induction step.

## References

- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch10_induction.tex`
-/

/-! ### Answer-valued successor restrictions

The preceding lemmas start from an ordinary successor strategy and build the
answer-valued slice profile used in the current Section 6 successor route.  For
the simultaneous answer-valued induction theorem, the successor strategy itself
has answer-valued diagonal measurements.  The next definitions and lemmas
record the corresponding restricted-probability theorem without replacing that
diagonal measurement by an ordinary low-degree realization.
-/
theorems.theorem_title: Answer Successor Weighted Axis Parallel Bound

theorems.formal_statement:
lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.weighted_bound_to_average
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    {a b : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error}
    (h : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceTransverseDirectionWeight params * a ≤ b) :
    a ≤ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * b := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Remove the transverse-direction weight from an averaged restricted bound.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

# Section 6 -- Restricted Probability Common Lemmas

This module contains the averaging and scalar normalization lemmas shared by the
axis-parallel, diagonal, and answer-valued restricted-probability bounds.

- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch10_induction.tex`
-/

theorems.theorem_title: Weighted Bound To Average

theorems.formal_statement:
lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerRestrictedProbabilitiesStatement.ofWeightedBounds
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (haxisWeightedBound :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
          (fun x => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceTransverseDirectionWeight params *
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStrat params strategy x).axisParallelFailureProbability) ≤ eps)
    (hdiagonalWeightedBound :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
          (fun x => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceTransverseDirectionWeight params *
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStrat params strategy x).diagonalFailureProbability) ≤ gamma) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerRestrictedProbabilitiesStatement params strategy eps delta gamma := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Data answer-valued weighted restricted axis/diagonal bounds into the public
answer-valued restricted-probabilities statement.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerRestrictedProbabilitiesStatement.ofWeightedBounds`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

/-!
# Section 6 -- Answer-Valued Restricted Probability Statement

This module contains the answer-valued form of the restricted-probability
bookkeeping for the main induction step.

## References

- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch10_induction.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep

open MIPStarRE.LDT
open scoped MatrixOrder

universe uF uι

variable {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
theorems.theorem_title: Of Weighted Bounds

theorems.formal_statement:
lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerSuccessorRestrictedProbabilitiesStatement.ofWeightedBounds
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (haxisWeightedBound :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
          (fun x => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceTransverseDirectionWeight params *
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStratOfAnswer params strategy x).axisParallelFailureProbability)
        ≤ eps)
    (hdiagonalWeightedBound :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
          (fun x => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceTransverseDirectionWeight params *
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStratOfAnswer params strategy x).diagonalFailureProbability)
        ≤ gamma) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerSuccessorRestrictedProbabilitiesStatement params strategy eps delta gamma := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Assemble the weighted answer-valued successor restricted-probability bounds
into the averaged statement.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerSuccessorRestrictedProbabilitiesStatement.ofWeightedBounds`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

# Section 6 -- Answer-Valued Restricted Probability Statement

This module contains the answer-valued form of the restricted-probability
bookkeeping for the main induction step.

## References

- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch10_induction.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

universe uF uι

/-! ### Answer-valued successor restrictions

The preceding lemmas start from an ordinary successor strategy and build the
answer-valued slice profile used in the current Section 6 successor route.  For
the simultaneous answer-valued induction theorem, the successor strategy itself
has answer-valued diagonal measurements.  The next definitions and lemmas
record the corresponding restricted-probability theorem without replacing that
diagonal measurement by an ordinary low-degree realization.
-/
theorems.theorem_title: Of Weighted Bounds

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessorRestrictedSliceConclusions
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.{uF} params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hinduction : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerMainInductionHypothesis.{uF, uι} params)
    (hk_next : 400 * params.next.m * params.next.d ≤ k)
    (hsmall : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma < 1) :
    ∃ profile : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerSuccessorRestrictedFailureProfile params strategy,
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedAxisParallelError params profile ≤
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * eps ∧
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedSelfConsistencyError params profile ≤ delta ∧
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedDiagonalError params profile ≤
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * gamma ∧
        ∀ x,
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerMainInductionConclusion params
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStratOfAnswer params strategy x)
            (profile.axisParallel x)
            (profile.selfConsistency x)
            (profile.diagonal x)
            k := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Recursive predecessor conclusions for the answer-valued successor slices.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessorRestrictedSliceConclusions`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

# Section 6 -- Answer-Valued Restricted Probability Statement

This module contains the answer-valued form of the restricted-probability
bookkeeping for the main induction step.

- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch10_induction.tex`

/-! ### Answer-valued successor restrictions

The preceding lemmas start from an ordinary successor strategy and build the
answer-valued slice profile used in the current Section 6 successor route.  For
the simultaneous answer-valued induction theorem, the successor strategy itself
has answer-valued diagonal measurements.  The next definitions and lemmas
record the corresponding restricted-probability theorem without replacing that
diagonal measurement by an ordinary low-degree realization.
-/
theorems.theorem_title: Answer Successor Restricted Slice Conclusions

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessorRecursiveSliceMeasurements_ofMainInductionHypothesis
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.{uF} params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hinduction : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerMainInductionHypothesis.{uF, uι} params)
    (hk_next : 400 * params.next.m * params.next.d ≤ k)
    (hsmall : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma < 1) :
    ∃ profile : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerSuccessorRestrictedFailureProfile params strategy,
      ∃ sliceError : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error,
        ∃ sliceMeasurement : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ι,
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedAxisParallelError params profile ≤
              _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * eps ∧
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedSelfConsistencyError params profile ≤ delta ∧
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedDiagonalError params profile ≤
              _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * gamma ∧
            (∀ x,
              _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
                (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas
                  (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStratOfAnswer params strategy x).pointMeasurement)
                (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params (sliceMeasurement x).toSubMeas)
                (sliceError x)) ∧
            (∀ x,
              sliceError x ≤
                _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params k
                  (profile.axisParallel x)
                  (profile.selfConsistency x)
                  (profile.diagonal x)) ∧
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params)) sliceError ≤
              ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)) *
                (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma +
                  Real.exp (-((k : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / (80000 * ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)))))) := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Extract the recursive answer-valued slice measurements and their averaged
main-induction error bound.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessorRecursiveSliceMeasurements_ofMainInductionHypothesis`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessorSelfImprovementOutputs_ofMainInductionHypothesis
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.{uF} params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hinduction : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerMainInductionHypothesis.{uF, uι} params)
    (hk_next : 400 * params.next.m * params.next.d ≤ k)
    (hsmall : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma < 1) :
    ∃ profile : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerSuccessorRestrictedFailureProfile params strategy,
      ∃ sliceError : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error,
        ∃ sliceMeasurement : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ι,
          ∃ sliceProj : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjSubMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ι,
            ∃ sliceWitness : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι,
              _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedAxisParallelError params profile ≤
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * eps ∧
                _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedSelfConsistencyError params profile ≤ delta ∧
                _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.averageAnswerSuccessorRestrictedDiagonalError params profile ≤
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.sliceConditioningLoss params * gamma ∧
                (∀ x,
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas
                      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStratOfAnswer params strategy x).pointMeasurement)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params (sliceMeasurement x).toSubMeas)
                    (sliceError x)) ∧
                (∀ x,
                  sliceError x ≤
                    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params k
                      (profile.axisParallel x)
                      (profile.selfConsistency x)
                      (profile.diagonal x)) ∧
                _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params)) sliceError ≤
                  ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)) *
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma +
                      Real.exp (-((k : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / (80000 * ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)))))) ∧
                _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
                    (fun x =>
                      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params
                        (profile.axisParallel x)
                        (profile.selfConsistency x)
                        (profile.diagonal x)) ≤
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma ∧
                (∀ x,
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.CompletenessAtLeast strategy.state (sliceProj x).toSubMeas.liftLeft
                    ((1 - sliceError x) -
                      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params
                        (profile.axisParallel x)
                        (profile.selfConsistency x)
                        (profile.diagonal x))) ∧
                (∀ x,
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas
                      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.xRestrictedAnswerSymStratOfAnswer params strategy x).pointMeasurement)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params (sliceProj x).toSubMeas)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params
                      (profile.axisParallel x)
                      (profile.selfConsistency x)
                      (profile.diagonal x))) ∧
                (∀ x,
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.BipartiteSSCRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (sliceProj x).toSubMeas)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params
                      (profile.axisParallel x)
                      (profile.selfConsistency x)
                      (profile.diagonal x))) ∧
                (∀ x,
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftPlacedSubMeas (ιB := ι) (sliceProj x).toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightPlacedSubMeas (ιA := ι) (sliceProj x).toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params
                      (profile.axisParallel x)
                      (profile.selfConsistency x)
                      (profile.diagonal x))) ∧
                (∀ x,
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.tensorFailureExpectation strategy.state (sliceWitness x) (sliceProj x).toSubMeas
                    ≤ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params
                      (profile.axisParallel x)
                      (profile.selfConsistency x)
                      (profile.diagonal x)) ∧
                (∀ x, ∀ h : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params,
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.averagedSlicePointEvaluationOperator
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSelfImprovementCarrier params.next strategy) x h ≤ sliceWitness x) := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Apply self-improvement to the recursive answer-valued successor slices.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessorSelfImprovementOutputs_ofMainInductionHypothesis`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

/-!
# Section 6 — Averaged Slice Error Bounds: Successor Outputs

This module packages recursive answer-valued slice measurements and the final
self-improvement-to-main-induction error comparisons.
-/

@[expose] public section

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep

open MIPStarRE.LDT
open scoped MatrixOrder

universe uι uF

theorems.theorem_title: Answer Successor Self Improvement Outputs Of Main Induction Hypothesis

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessorAveragedFamilyFields_ofMainInductionHypothesis.{uι', uF}
    {ι' : Type uι'} [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.{uF} params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι')
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hinduction : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerMainInductionHypothesis.{uF, uι'} params)
    (hk_next : 400 * params.next.m * params.next.d ≤ k)
    (hsmall : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma < 1) :
    ∃ family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι',
      ∃ kappa : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error,
        family.Complete strategy.state kappa ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.evaluatedAtNextPoint family)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma) ∧
          family.StronglySelfConsistent strategy.state
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma) ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.SliceBoundednessInput
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSelfImprovementCarrier params.next strategy)
            family
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma) ∧
          kappa ≤
            ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)) *
                (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma +
                  Real.exp (-((k : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / (80000 * ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ))))))
              + _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma ≤
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Assemble the averaged polynomial family fields in the answer-valued
successor route.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSuccessorAveragedFamilyFields_ofMainInductionHypothesis`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

/-!
# Section 5 — Locality-preserving projectivization repair

This file proves the locality-preserving repair route for the late Section 5
`Q/X/XHat/P` argument.

## Scope

The **spectral-truncation stage** (the first part of the proof of rounding
to projectors) is already proved by
`spectralTruncationStatement_of_sourceAlmostProjective` in
`MakingMeasurementsProjective/SpectralTruncation/ProjectiveNonMeasurement.lean`,
which is fully proved via
`projectiveNonMeasurement_of_sourceAlmostProjective_full`. Proofs that
require the spectral truncation statement should call that declaration directly.

The main result recorded here:

- **`leftLiftedProjectivizationRepair`** — paper origin
  `references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex` lines 534–860 (rank
  reduction and the `Q`/`√Q` completeness setup) and 862–1194 (the
  `X`/`X̂`/`P` algebra producing the lifted projective sub-measurement,
  including the final triangle-inequality assembly).  The formal proof below
  follows that local `Q/X/XHat/P` route by passing to the left marginal state,
  constructing the local projective family there, and transporting the final
  estimate back to left lifts.

The theorem proved here is the direct output of that route under a normalized
bipartite state and the source almost-projective estimate for the left-lifted
measurement. It is stated directly in terms of this estimate, rather than in
terms of a separate repair-input assumption, and provides the unconditional
repair step used by the orthonormalization theorem.
-/

# Section 5 — basic projectivization data

This module contains the scalar estimates and elementary transport lemmas used
by the orthonormalization projectivization chain.  The mathematical source is the
orthonormalization-and-completion argument in `inductive_step.tex`, lines
130--149, together with the orthonormalization theorem and the completion
proposition cited there.

The declarations here are deliberately prior to the construction of the final
projective measurements.  They record the literal scalar obtained by composing
orthonormalization with completion, its absorbed form in the unit-error regime,
the right-register transport available under permutation invariance, and the
residual hypotheses passed to the self-consistency handoff theorem.  The actual
projective-measurement output theorem is in `ProjectivizationChain.Output`.

The scalar computation is

    ζ₂ = 2 · (100·ζ^{1/4}) + 4 · √(100·ζ^{1/4}) + 2·ζ
       = 200·ζ^{1/4} + 40·ζ^{1/8} + 2·ζ.

The paper prints the closed form `ζ₂ = 200·ζ^{1/4} + 40·ζ^{1/8}`.  The Lean
cascade uses the slightly widened absorbed scalar
`200·ζ^{1/4} + 42·ζ^{1/8}` downstream, since in the non-vacuous regime
`0 ≤ ζ ≤ 1` gives `2·ζ ≤ 2·ζ^{1/8}`.

  The theorem has a tracked proof gap for the sharp paper constant; this file
  no longer exposes its proof-stage construction data as a hypothesis of the

  (`\leanok` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch03_preliminaries.tex`), so no new
  bridge is introduced here.

  `Preliminaries.completeAtOutcomeProj`, whose proof relies only on the
  existing facts that `P.total` is a projection and that each `P_a` is
  absorbed by `P.total`.

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGAdjacentStageM4_head_sum
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι) (ℓ n : ℕ)
    (b : Bool) (τ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatType n) (x : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params) (xs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params n) :
    (∑ g ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params)) with g.isSome = b,
        ∑ gs ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n)) with
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs = τ,
          let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit b τ)
          let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family x).outcome g
          let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (T * Tᴴ) *
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (S * U * U))) =
      ∑ gs ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n)) with
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs = τ,
        let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit b τ)
        let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
        let B := if b then (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.completePartSubMeas params family x).total
          else (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.incompletePartSubMeas params family x).total
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (T * Tᴴ) * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (S * B)) := by sorry

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToG_avgOver_tail_type_ev
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι) (n : ℕ) (τ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatType n)
    (B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params n)) (fun xs =>
      ∑ gs ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n)) with
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs = τ,
        let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (T * Tᴴ) * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) B)) =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.averagedSandwichByTypeSubMeas params family n τ).total *
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) B) := by sorry

    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (ℓ n : ℕ) (x : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params) (xs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params n) :
    (∑ b : Bool, ∑ τ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatType n,
      ∑ g ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params)) with g.isSome = b,
        ∑ gs ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n)) with
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs = τ,
          let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit b τ)
          let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family x).outcome g
          let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (U * T * Tᴴ) *
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (S * U))) =
      ∑ g : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params, ∑ gs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n,
        let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit g.isSome (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs))
        let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family x).outcome g
        let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (U * T) *
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) Tᴴ * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (S * U))) := by sorry

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGAdjacentStageM2_pointwise_halfSandwichRightAdjointShape
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (ℓ n : ℕ) (x : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params) (xs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params n) :
    (∑ b : Bool, ∑ τ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatType n,
      ∑ g ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params)) with g.isSome = b,
        ∑ gs ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n)) with
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs = τ,
          let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit b τ)
          let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family x).outcome g
          let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (T * U * Tᴴ) *
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (S * U))) =
      ∑ g : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params, ∑ gs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n,
        let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit g.isSome (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs))
        let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family x).outcome g
        let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) T *
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (U * Tᴴ) * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (S * U))) := by sorry

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGAdjacentStageM1_pointwise_rightShape
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (ℓ n : ℕ) (x : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params) (xs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params n) :
    (∑ b : Bool, ∑ τ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatType n,
      ∑ g ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params)) with g.isSome = b,
        ∑ gs ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n)) with
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs = τ,
          let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit b τ)
          let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family x).outcome g
          let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (U * T * Tᴴ) *
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (S * U))) =
      ∑ g : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params, ∑ gs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n,
        let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit g.isSome (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs))
        let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family x).outcome g
        let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (U * T * Tᴴ) * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) S) *
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) U) := by sorry

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGAdjacentStageM3_eq_finalLeftShape
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι) (k ℓ : ℕ) :
    let n := k - (ℓ + 1)
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGAdjacentStageM3 params ψbi family k ℓ =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params × _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params n)) fun q =>
        ∑ g : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params, ∑ gs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n,
          let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit g.isSome (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs))
          let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family q.1).outcome g
          let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n q.2 gs
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (T * Tᴴ) * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) (S * U)) *
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) U) := by sorry

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGAdjacentStageM1_eq_rightShape
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι) (k ℓ : ℕ) :
    let n := k - (ℓ + 1)
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGAdjacentStageM1 params ψbi family k ℓ =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params × _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params n)) fun q =>
        ∑ g : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params, ∑ gs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n,
          let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit g.isSome (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs))
          let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family q.1).outcome g
          let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n q.2 gs
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (U * T * Tᴴ) * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) S) *
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) U) := by sorry

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGTailStageMass_cons_eq_adjacentStageA0_branch
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (ℓ n : ℕ) (b : Bool) (τ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatType n) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGTailStageMass params ψbi family ℓ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit b τ) =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params)) fun x =>
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params n)) fun xs =>
          ∑ g ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params)) with g.isSome = b,
            ∑ gs ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params n)) with
                _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatTupleType gs = τ,
              let S := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToGRecurrenceWeight params family ℓ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.prependTypeBit b τ)
              let U := (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family x).outcome g
              let T := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatHalfProductOutcomeOperator params family n xs gs
              _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (U * T * Tᴴ * U) *
                _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) S) := by sorry

    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (zeta : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hcompleted :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel ψbi
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.SliceQuestion params))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatSelfConsistencyLeftFamily params family)

    {n : ℕ} :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params × _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params n)) (fun q =>

          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι) ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family q.1).outcome g))) ≤

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.fromHToG_ev_sum_isSome_sandwich_weight
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι) (x : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params)
    (b : Bool) (A S : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    (∑ g ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatOutcome params)) with g.isSome = b,
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) A *
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι)
            (S * (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.gHatIdxMeas params family x).outcome g * S))) =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) A *
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι)
          (S * (if b then (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.completePartSubMeas params family x).total
            else (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.incompletePartSubMeas params family x).total) * S)) := by sorry

      (ι × ι))
    (δ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.interpolationEligibleSandwich_exists_mismatch_sum_le_sum
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    {k : ℕ}
    (u : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params)
    (xs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PointTuple params k)
    (f : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial params.next) :
    (∑ gs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params k,
        if ∃ i : Fin k, ∃ hiSome : (gs i).isSome = true,
            ((gs i).get hiSome) u ≠ f (xs i) then
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.interpolationEligibleSandwichFamily params family k xs).outcome gs
        else 0)
      ≤
      ∑ i : Fin k,
        ∑ gs : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.GHatTupleOutcome params k,
          if ∃ hiSome : (gs i).isSome = true,
              ((gs i).get hiSome) u ≠ f (xs i) then
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.interpolationEligibleSandwichFamily params family k xs).outcome gs
          else 0 := by sorry

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.switcherooAggregate_qSDDOp_expand
    {Outcome : Type*} [Fintype Outcome]
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (ψbi : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (ι × ι))
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjSubMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params) Outcome ι)
    (q : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.SlicePairQuestion params) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.qSDDOp ψbi
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.switcherooAggregateLeft params family M q)
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.switcherooAggregateRight params family M q)
      =
        ∑ o : Outcome,
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi
              (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι)
                ((M q.2).outcome o *
                  (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.completePartSubMeas params family q.1).total *
                  (M q.2).outcome o)) +
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi
              (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι)
                ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.completePartSubMeas params family q.1).total *
                  (M q.2).outcome o *
                  (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.completePartSubMeas params family q.1).total)) -
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi
              (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι)
                ((M q.2).outcome o *
                  (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.completePartSubMeas params family q.1).total *
                  (M q.2).outcome o *
                  (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.completePartSubMeas params family q.1).total)) -
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev ψbi
              (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor (ι₂ := ι)
                ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.completePartSubMeas params family q.1).total *
                  (M q.2).outcome o *
                  (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.completePartSubMeas params family q.1).total *
                  (M q.2).outcome o))) := by sorry

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.evaluatedSlice_phaseFour_pointSwap_right_bound_of_commutativityPoints
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SymStrat params.next ι)
    (gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hnorm : strategy.state.IsNormalized)
    (hcomm :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDOpRel strategy.state
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.GlobalVariance.PointPairQuestion params.next))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.CommutativityPoints.pointMeasurementProductLeft params.next strategy)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.CommutativityPoints.pointMeasurementProductRight params.next strategy)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.CommutativityPoints.commutativityPointsError params.next gamma))
    (C : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceQuestion params →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceOutcome params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ι × ι))
    (hC : ∀ q, ∑ ab : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceOutcome params, C q ab * (C q ab)ᴴ ≤ 1) :
    let 𝒟 := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceQuestion params)
    let inserted : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceQuestion params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error := fun q =>
      ∑ ab : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceOutcome params,
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev strategy.state
          (C q ab *
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι)
              (((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.evaluatedSlicePointMeas params strategy q.2).outcome ab.2) *
               ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.evaluatedSlicePointMeas params strategy q.1).outcome ab.1)))
    let swapped : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceQuestion params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error := fun q =>
      ∑ ab : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceOutcome params,
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ev strategy.state
          (C q ab *
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightTensor (ι₁ := ι)
              (((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.evaluatedSlicePointMeas params strategy q.1).outcome ab.1) *
               ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.evaluatedSlicePointMeas params strategy q.2).outcome ab.2)))
    |_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver 𝒟 inserted - _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver 𝒟 swapped| ≤
      6 * Real.sqrt (gamma * (((params.m + 1 : ℕ)) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)) := by sorry

    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters) [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SymStrat params.next ι)

    (_hnorm : strategy.state.IsNormalized)

        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.GlobalVariance.PointPairQuestion params.next))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.CommutativityPoints.pointMeasurementProductLeft params.next strategy)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.CommutativityPoints.pointMeasurementProductRight params.next strategy)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.CommutativityPoints.commutativityPointsError params.next gamma))
    (_hgamma_nonneg : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (G : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SubMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ι)
    (_hG : ∀ x, G x = (family.meas x).toSubMeas)
    (_hcons : family.ConsistentWithPoints strategy zeta)
    (_hself : family.StronglySelfConsistent strategy.state zeta)
    (_hbound : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.SliceBoundednessInput strategy family zeta)
    (_hpostSSC : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.evaluatedPointFamilyLeft params family)
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.evaluatedPointFamilyRight params family)
      zeta) :
    2 *
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceQuestion params))
          (fun q => ∑ ab : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceOutcome params,
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.evaluatedSliceABATerm params strategy family q ab) -
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceQuestion params))
          (fun q => ∑ ab : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.EvaluatedSliceOutcome params,
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.evaluatedSliceABABTerm params strategy family q ab)) ≤
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.commDataProcessedGError params gamma zeta := by sorry

(`references/ldt-paper/commutativity-G.tex`, lines 72–131).
Starting from `E[∑ ABAB]`, the proof applies ten approximation steps:

1. `≈_{2√ζ}`: insert Bob's measurement via `closenessOfIP` + `eq:add-an-a`
2. `≈_{√ζ}`: remove trailing `G^y` (`clm:g-comm-stability`)
3. `≈_{2√ζ}`: insert Bob's second measurement via `closenessOfIP` +
   `eq:add-an-a`
4. `≈_{6√(γ(m+1))}`: swap Bob's measurements via `closenessOfIP` +
   `commutativityPoints`
5a. `≈_{6√(γ(m+1))}`: the point-measurement swap contribution internal
    to the paper's `clm:g-comm-stability2` accounting
5b. `≈_{√ζ}`: remove trailing `G^x` by the boundedness part of
    `gCommStabilityTwo_raw_scalar` (this is the scalar part of `hphase5paper` below)
6–7. `≈_{2√ζ + 2√ζ}`: reverse the `eq:add-an-a` insertions
8–9. `≈_{√ζ + √ζ}`: apply postprocessed self-consistency twice

Summing: `Σεᵢ = 12√ζ + 12√(γ(m+1))`, so `2 * Σεᵢ ≤ 48m(√γ + √ζ)`. -/
theorems.theorem_title: Evaluated Slice Scalar Chain Bound

# Processed `G` scalar approximation

This file assembles the paper-faithful evaluated-slice scalar chain used in the proof of
`lem:comm-data-processed-g` (`references/ldt-paper/commutativity-G.tex`, lines 72–131).
The heavier endpoint and normalization lemmas are imported from
`ScalarApproximation.PaperChain` so this final assembly can reuse cached proofs.

**Proof strategy:** The proof follows the paper's exact route of ten approximation steps
using `closenessOfIP`, `commutativityPoints`, `gCommStability_scalar`, and
`gCommStabilityTwo_raw_scalar`.  Every `≈_{ε}` step in the paper corresponds to a
named `hphase` block below, and the final error budget `48m(√γ + √ζ)` matches
the paper's displayed computation at line 129.  The only presentation difference
is that the Lean chain terminates at the `BAB` average and then applies the
*exact* swap-symmetry identity `avgBAB = avgABA` (see
`EvaluatedSliceCommutation/Averages.lean`) rather than directly chaining to `ABA`;
this is an equality, not an approximation, and does not affect the error budget.

## Module organization

The formerly monolithic file has been split into focused leaf modules:

- `ProcessedG.PhaseTwo`: Phase 2 stability-defect infrastructure
  (`evaluatedSlicePhaseTwoStabilityDefect`, finite reindexing, subtraction algebra)
- `ProcessedG.MainChain`: The main `evaluatedSlice_scalar_chain_bound` assembly

This file provides the public statement of `commDataProcessedG`, the paper-facing
scalar approximation theorem.
-/

/-! ### Scalar approximation chain (proof of `lem:comm-data-processed-g`)

The paper's proof (`commutativity-G.tex`, lines 72–131) converts
`E[∑ ABAB]` into `E[∑ ABA]` through a ten-step scalar chain.
In the Lean development, this argument is packaged into a single bound
lemma (`evaluatedSlice_scalar_chain_bound`), and the proof is organized
conceptually into the following four phases.

**Phase 1** (eq:gcom8 → eq:gcom9): insert Bob's measurement and apply
`clm:g-comm-stability` to remove trailing `G^y`.
Error: `2√ζ + √ζ`.

**Phase 2** (eq:gcom9 → eq:gcom10): insert Bob's second measurement,
swap via `commutativityPoints`, then apply the boundedness part of
`clm:g-comm-stability2` to remove trailing `G^x`.  The paper states
`clm:g-comm-stability2` with an additional internal `6√(γ(m+1))` point-swap
loss (the constant 6 comes from `Real.sqrt(32) ≤ 6` in
`evaluatedSlice_phaseFour_pointSwap_right_bound`); the local `hphase5paper`
step below keeps the paper's combined `√ζ + 6√(γ(m+1))` contribution explicit.
Error: `2√ζ + 6√(γ(m+1)) + √ζ + 6√(γ(m+1))`.

**Phase 3** (eq:gcom10 → eq:gonna-cite-this-in-just-a-bit): reverse the
`eq:add-an-a` insertions using projectivity.
Error: `2√ζ + 2√ζ`.

**Phase 4** (eq:gonna-cite-this-in-just-a-bit → BAB = ABA): apply postprocessed
self-consistency twice, arriving at the `BAB` average, then use the exact
swap-symmetry identity `avgBAB = avgABA` (see `evaluatedSliceCommutation_avg_swap_terms`).
Error: `√ζ + √ζ`.

Total: `12√ζ + 12√(γ(m+1))`. Then `2 * total ≤ 48m(√γ + √ζ)`. -/

# Section 11 commutativity: final results

Top-level `thm:com-main` statement, lifting evaluated commutation back to
full-slice commutation via the two-step Schwartz–Zippel marginalization.

The two-step lift uses a hybrid scalar/tensor architecture (Option 3):
the public conclusion is an `SDDOpRel` on operator families, composed from
scalar transport lemmas whose proofs internally use tensor-form intermediates
for the PSD Schwartz–Zippel argument.
See `docs/decisions/713-scalar-tensor-decision.md`.

## References

- `references/ldt-paper/commutativity-points.tex`
- `references/ldt-paper/commutativity-G.tex`
- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch08_commutativity.tex`
-/

theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerComMainForCarrier_ofAnswerGood
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma zeta : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hgamma_nonneg : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (hcons :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.evaluatedAtNextPoint family)
        zeta)
    (hself : family.StronglySelfConsistent strategy.state zeta)
    (hbound :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.SliceBoundednessInput
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSelfImprovementCarrier params.next strategy)
        family zeta) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Commutativity.ComMainConclusion params
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSelfImprovementCarrier params.next strategy) family gamma zeta := by sorry
