    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma kappa zeta : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (haxis : strategy.axisParallelFailureProbability ≤ eps)
    (hselfBound : strategy.selfConsistencyFailureProbability ≤ delta)
    (heps_nonneg : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hdelta_nonneg : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hgamma_nonneg : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (hcomplete : family.Complete strategy.state kappa)
    (hcons : family.ConsistentWithPoints strategy zeta)
    (hd_zero : params.d = 0)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ H : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params.next) ι,
      H =
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.completeAtOutcome
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.averagedSliceAppendedSubMeas params family)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.pastedFallbackOutcome params) ∧
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params.next H.toSubMeas)
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.ldPastingInInductionError params k
            eps delta gamma kappa zeta) := by sorry

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerLdPastingInInductionSectionDegreeZeroOfSmallError
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hsmall : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma < 1)
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (kappa : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hcomplete : family.Complete strategy.state kappa)
    (hcons :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.evaluatedAtNextPoint family)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma))
    (_hself :
      family.StronglySelfConsistent strategy.state
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma))
    (_hbound :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.SliceBoundednessInput
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerSelfImprovementCarrier params.next strategy)
        family
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma))
    (hkappa_le :
      kappa ≤
        ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)) *
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma +
              Real.exp (-((k : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / (80000 * ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ))))))
          + _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma)
    (hzeta_le_nu :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.selfImprovementInInductionError params.next eps delta gamma ≤
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionNu params.next k eps delta gamma)
    (_hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k)
    (hd_zero : params.d = 0) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerMainInductionConclusion params.next strategy eps delta gamma k := by sorry

lemma LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.ldSandwichLineOnePoint_endpoint_ldGbcon_of_axis_self
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta zeta : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (haxis : strategy.axisParallelFailureProbability ≤ eps)
    (hself : strategy.selfConsistencyFailureProbability ≤ delta)
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (hcons : family.ConsistentWithPoints strategy zeta) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params × _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq params))
      (fun ux => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.postprocess (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.evaluateAt params ux.1 ((family.meas ux.2).toSubMeas)) some)
      (fun ux =>
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.postprocess
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Pasting.ldSandwichLineOnePointRightEndpointMeasurement params strategy ux).toSubMeas
          some)
        (zeta + Real.sqrt (8 * (params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) * eps + 4 * delta)) := by sorry

/-!
# Section 6 — Pasting Assembly: Answer-Valued Fields

This module assembles the answer-valued averaged family fields and the
commutativity input used by the pasting theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep

open MIPStarRE.LDT
open scoped MatrixOrder

universe uι

variable {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
theorems.theorem_title: Answer Ld Pasting In Induction Section Of Com Main And Error Bound

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.answerLdPastingInInductionSectionOfSmallError
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AnswerSymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hsmall : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma < 1)
    (family : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily params ι)
    (kappa : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hcomplete : family.Complete strategy.state kappa)
    (hcons :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxPolyFamily.evaluatedAtNextPoint family)

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionFromStageData.{uι', uF}
    {ι' : Type uι'} [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
    {_fieldUniverse : Type uF}
    (_fieldPoint : _fieldUniverse)
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.{uF} params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SymStrat params.next ι')
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hrestrict : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.SliceRestrictionData.{uι', uF} params strategy eps delta gamma)
    (hinduction : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.PerSliceInductionData.{uι', uF} params strategy eps delta gamma hrestrict k)
    (hself : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.SelfImprovementData.{uι', uF} params strategy eps delta gamma k hrestrict
      hinduction)
    (hpaste : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AveragedPastingData.{uι', uF} params strategy eps delta gamma k hself)
    (hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k) :
    ∃ H : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params.next) ι',
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params.next H.toSubMeas)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma) := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Compose the four paper-faithful induction-step inputs
restrict → induct → self-improve → paste into the main-induction conclusion in
one higher dimension.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

theorems.theorem_title: Main Induction From Stage Data

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionSuccessorNext_ofAnswerCarrier.{uF}
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.{uF} params.q]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SymStrat params.next ι)
    (eps delta gamma : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : strategy.IsGood eps delta gamma)
    (hsmall : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma < 1)
    (hinduction : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.AnswerMainInductionHypothesis.{uF, uι} params)
    (hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k) :
    ∃ G : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params.next) ι,
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params.next))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params.next G.toSubMeas)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params.next k eps delta gamma) := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Internal successor assembly from the predecessor induction hypothesis,
using the answer-valued slice self-improvement construction.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionSuccessorNext_ofAnswerCarrier`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

  `cascadeZeta1_nonneg`), used by the later cascade estimates.

/-!
# Main-formal scalar bounds

Scalar estimates for the two-space `mainFormal` theorem.  This module defines
the five scalars that appear in the paper's error calculation:

* `σ` — the symmetrized induction consistency error
* `ζ₁` — the cross-consistency error after unsymmetrization
* `ζ₂` — the orthonormalize-and-complete closeness error
* `ζ₃` — the projective self-consistency error
* `ζ₄` — the final point-consistency error

The core structure `MainFormalScalarBounds` (Prop) bundles the three
hypotheses needed to invoke the checked Step 8 bound
`errorCascade_le_mainFormalError`:

* `cascadeHypotheses` — the standing scalar regime (`q > 0`, `k ≥ 1`,
  `m ≥ 1`, `0 ≤ ε ≤ 1`, `d ≤ q`).
* `inductionNu_nonneg` — nonnegativity of the symmetrized main-induction
  `ν` at `(3ε, 3ε, 3ε)`.
* `inductionNu_bound` — the paper line 71–73 coarsening
  `ν ≤ 10000 k² m² (ε^{1/1024} + (d/q)^{1/1024})`.

The cascade comparisons `ζ₁ ≤ …`, `ζ₃ ≤ 2·mainFormalError`, etc. are then
derived in the private theorem `cascadeBounds` via
`errorCascade_le_mainFormalError`, which calls the already-formalized
scalar cascade estimates from `LDT.Test.MainTheorem.ScalarBounds`.  The module also
provides the vacuous-branch analysis (`mainFormalError_ge_one_of_*`) and
the coarsening lemma that absorbs `orthonormalizeAndCompleteError` into
`ζ₂` (`orthonormalizeAndCompleteError_zeta1_le_zeta2`).

## References

* Paper: `references/ldt-paper/inductive_step.tex`,
  error computations (lines 68–75, 186–234).
* Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapter/ch10_induction.tex`,
  `\label{def:main-formal-error-cascade}`,
  `\label{thm:sigma-bound-main-formal}`, and
  `\label{thm:zeta-bounds-main-formal}`.
-/

theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalInductionNu_bound {params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters} {k : ℕ} {eps : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error}
    (h : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.CascadeHypotheses params k eps) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalInductionNu params k eps ≤
      10000 * ((k : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)) * ((params.m : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)) *
        (Real.rpow eps (1 / (1024 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)) +
          Real.rpow ((params.d : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / (params.q : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)) (1 / (1024 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error))) := by sorry

/-!
# Main-formal scalar bounds

Scalar estimates for the two-space `mainFormal` theorem.  This module defines
the five scalars that appear in the paper's error calculation:

* `σ` — the symmetrized induction consistency error
* `ζ₁` — the cross-consistency error after unsymmetrization
* `ζ₂` — the orthonormalize-and-complete closeness error
* `ζ₃` — the projective self-consistency error
* `ζ₄` — the final point-consistency error

The core structure `MainFormalScalarBounds` (Prop) bundles the three
hypotheses needed to invoke the checked Step 8 bound
`errorCascade_le_mainFormalError`:

* `cascadeHypotheses` — the standing scalar regime (`q > 0`, `k ≥ 1`,
  `m ≥ 1`, `0 ≤ ε ≤ 1`, `d ≤ q`).
* `inductionNu_nonneg` — nonnegativity of the symmetrized main-induction
  `ν` at `(3ε, 3ε, 3ε)`.
* `inductionNu_bound` — the paper line 71–73 coarsening
  `ν ≤ 10000 k² m² (ε^{1/1024} + (d/q)^{1/1024})`.

The cascade comparisons `ζ₁ ≤ …`, `ζ₃ ≤ 2·mainFormalError`, etc. are then
derived in the private theorem `cascadeBounds` via
`errorCascade_le_mainFormalError`, which calls the already-formalized
scalar cascade estimates from `LDT.Test.MainTheorem.ScalarBounds`.  The module also
provides the vacuous-branch analysis (`mainFormalError_ge_one_of_*`) and
the coarsening lemma that absorbs `orthonormalizeAndCompleteError` into
`ζ₂` (`orthonormalizeAndCompleteError_zeta1_le_zeta2`).

## References

* Paper: `references/ldt-paper/inductive_step.tex`,
  error computations (lines 68–75, 186–234).
* Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapter/ch10_induction.tex`,
  `\label{def:main-formal-error-cascade}`,
  `\label{thm:sigma-bound-main-formal}`, and
  `\label{thm:zeta-bounds-main-formal}`.
-/

/-!
# Main-formal scalar bounds

Scalar estimates for the two-space `mainFormal` theorem.  This module defines
the five scalars that appear in the paper's error calculation:

* `σ` — the symmetrized induction consistency error
* `ζ₁` — the cross-consistency error after unsymmetrization
* `ζ₂` — the orthonormalize-and-complete closeness error
* `ζ₃` — the projective self-consistency error
* `ζ₄` — the final point-consistency error

The core structure `MainFormalScalarBounds` (Prop) bundles the three
hypotheses needed to invoke the checked Step 8 bound
`errorCascade_le_mainFormalError`:

* `cascadeHypotheses` — the standing scalar regime (`q > 0`, `k ≥ 1`,
  `m ≥ 1`, `0 ≤ ε ≤ 1`, `d ≤ q`).
* `inductionNu_nonneg` — nonnegativity of the symmetrized main-induction
  `ν` at `(3ε, 3ε, 3ε)`.
* `inductionNu_bound` — the paper line 71–73 coarsening
  `ν ≤ 10000 k² m² (ε^{1/1024} + (d/q)^{1/1024})`.

The cascade comparisons `ζ₁ ≤ …`, `ζ₃ ≤ 2·mainFormalError`, etc. are then
derived in the private theorem `cascadeBounds` via
`errorCascade_le_mainFormalError`, which calls the already-formalized
scalar cascade estimates from `LDT.Test.MainTheorem.ScalarBounds`.  The module also
provides the vacuous-branch analysis (`mainFormalError_ge_one_of_*`) and
the coarsening lemma that absorbs `orthonormalizeAndCompleteError` into
`ζ₂` (`orthonormalizeAndCompleteError_zeta1_le_zeta2`).

## References

* Paper: `references/ldt-paper/inductive_step.tex`,
  error computations (lines 68–75, 186–234).
* Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapter/ch10_induction.tex`,
  `\label{def:main-formal-error-cascade}`,
  `\label{thm:sigma-bound-main-formal}`, and
  `\label{thm:zeta-bounds-main-formal}`.
-/

theorems.theorem_title: Diagonal Role Average Nonneg

theorems.natural_language_statement:
Passing the two-space low individual degree test bounds the point-agreement
branch by 3ε.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.pointAgreementFailureProbability_le_three_mul`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.sourceRoleRegisterFullPolynomialSelfConsistency_ofPointConsistency
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
    (eps σ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hpass : strategy.PassesLowIndividualDegreeTest eps)
    (G_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA)
    (G_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB)
    (hpointAGB :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementA)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_B.toSubMeas)
        σ)
    (hGApointB :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_A.toSubMeas)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementB)
        σ) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas)
      (σ + 2 * Real.sqrt (3 * eps + σ) +
        (params.m * params.d : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / params.q) := by sorry

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

measurement on the heterogeneous role-register space
`Role × (ιA ⊕ ιB)`.  The Alice extraction is the block indexed by

theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.completedProjectiveMeasurementsAndLine169_ofTwoSidedSubmeasurements
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
    (G_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA)
    (G_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB)
    (P_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjSubMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA)
    (P_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjSubMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB)
    (ζ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hfull : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas) ζ)
    (hleft :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftPlacedSubMeas (ιB := ιB) G_A.toSubMeas))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftPlacedSubMeas (ιB := ιB) P_A.toSubMeas))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ))
    (hright :
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightPlacedSubMeas (ιA := ιA) G_B.toSubMeas))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightPlacedSubMeas (ιA := ιA) P_B.toSubMeas))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ)) :
    ∃ Q_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA,
      ∃ Q_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB,
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftPlacedSubMeas (ιB := ιB) G_A.toSubMeas))
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftPlacedSubMeas (ιB := ιB) Q_A.toSubMeas))
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizeAndCompleteError ζ) ∧
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightPlacedSubMeas (ιA := ιA) G_B.toSubMeas))
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightPlacedSubMeas (ιA := ιA) Q_B.toSubMeas))
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizeAndCompleteError ζ) ∧
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily Q_A.toSubMeas)
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas)
          (ζ + Real.sqrt (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ)) ∧
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
          (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily Q_B.toSubMeas)
          (ζ + Real.sqrt (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ)) := by sorry

theorems.theorem_title: Completed Projective Measurements And Line169 Of Two Sided Submeasurements

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.roleRegisterSymmStrategy_axisParallel_eq_roleAverage
    {params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters} [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    {ιA : Type*} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    {ιB : Type*} [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat params ιA ιB) :
    (strategy.roleRegisterSymmStrategy).axisParallelFailureProbability =
      strategy.axisParallelRoleAverage := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
The axis-parallel branch of the heterogeneous role-register symmetrization
is exactly the axis-parallel role average of the original two-space strategy.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

    (σ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hsym :

        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))

/-!
# Source-Boundary Role-Register Handoff: Core Reductions

This module contains the main-induction handoff, unsymmetrization, and the first
two-space projectivization outputs for the source route toward `thm:main-formal`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder _root_.Matrix ComplexOrder

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

open MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective

-- The proof compares two averaged consistency defects after expanding the
-- role-register symmetrization and polynomial-evaluation extraction maps.
theorems.theorem_title: Source Role Register Point Consistency Of Sym Consistency

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.sourceRoleRegisterTwoSidedProjectiveSubmeasurements
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
    (eps : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hpass : strategy.PassesLowIndividualDegreeTest eps)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k) :
    ∃ G_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA,
      ∃ G_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB,
        ∃ P_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjSubMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA,
          ∃ P_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjSubMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB,
            _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
                (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementA)
                (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_B.toSubMeas)
                (2 * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params k
                  (3 * eps) (3 * eps) (3 * eps)) ∧
              _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
                (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_A.toSubMeas)
                (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementB)
                (2 * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params k
                  (3 * eps) (3 * eps) (3 * eps)) ∧
              _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.sourceRoleRegisterCompletedProjectiveMeasurements
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
    (eps : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hpass : strategy.PassesLowIndividualDegreeTest eps)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k) :
    let σ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error :=
      2 * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params k (3 * eps) (3 * eps) (3 * eps)
    let ζ₁ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error :=
      σ + 2 * Real.sqrt (3 * eps + σ) + (params.m * params.d : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / params.q
    ∃ G_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA,
      ∃ G_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB,
        ∃ P_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjSubMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA,
          ∃ P_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjSubMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB,
            ∃ Q_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA,
              ∃ Q_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB,
                _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementA)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_B.toSubMeas)
                    σ ∧
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_A.toSubMeas)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementB)
                    σ ∧
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas)
                    ζ₁ ∧
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftPlacedSubMeas (ιB := ιB) G_A.toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftPlacedSubMeas (ιB := ιB) P_A.toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ₁) ∧
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightPlacedSubMeas (ιA := ιA) G_B.toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightPlacedSubMeas (ιA := ιA) P_B.toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ₁) ∧
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftPlacedSubMeas (ιB := ιB) G_A.toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.leftPlacedSubMeas (ιB := ιB) Q_A.toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizeAndCompleteError ζ₁) ∧
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SDDRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightPlacedSubMeas (ιA := ιA) G_B.toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.rightPlacedSubMeas (ιA := ιA) Q_B.toSubMeas))
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizeAndCompleteError ζ₁) ∧
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily Q_A.toSubMeas)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas)
                    (ζ₁ + Real.sqrt
                      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ₁)) ∧
                  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
                    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily Q_B.toSubMeas)
                    (ζ₁ + Real.sqrt
                      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ₁)) := by sorry
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Completed projective measurements from the source role-register route.

Under the parameters, finite-dimensional spaces, typeclass assumptions, and hypotheses specified in the formal statement, the asserted conclusion is:

$$\text{the proposition stated by this LIDT declaration holds.}$$

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

**Formalization Note.** The source declaration is `MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.sourceRoleRegisterCompletedProjectiveMeasurements`; its Lean statement gives the exact quantifier order and all boundary hypotheses.

# Source-Boundary Role-Register Handoff: Final Point Consistency

This module contains the final completed-measurement and point-consistency
statements used by the paper-facing `thm:main-formal` route.
-/

@[expose] public section

theorems.theorem_title: Source Role Register Completed Projective Measurements

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.sourceRoleRegisterFinalPointConsistency
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
    (eps : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hpass : strategy.PassesLowIndividualDegreeTest eps)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k) :
    let σ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error :=
      2 * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params k (3 * eps) (3 * eps) (3 * eps)
    let ζ₁ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error :=
      σ + 2 * Real.sqrt (3 * eps + σ) + (params.m * params.d : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / params.q
    let ζ₂ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizeAndCompleteError ζ₁
    let η : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error :=
      ζ₁ + Real.sqrt (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ₁)
    let ζ₃ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error := 6 * ζ₁ + 6 * ζ₂
    ∃ Q_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA,
      ∃ Q_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB,
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementA)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params Q_B.toSubMeas)
            (σ + 2 * Real.sqrt (η + ζ₃ / 2)) ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params Q_A.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementB)
            (σ + 2 * Real.sqrt (η + ζ₃ / 2)) ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params Q_A.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params Q_B.toSubMeas)
            (ζ₃ / 2) ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily Q_A.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily Q_B.toSubMeas)
            (ζ₃ / 2) := by sorry

Final point-consistency estimates obtained from the source role-register
route before scalar absorption.

This result is an importable step in the formal dependency graph for the quantum soundness proof of the classical low individual degree test.

Formalization credit: Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng, Yanqiao Zhu, and Zhengfeng Ji (arXiv:2609.19814). Mathematical source: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, and Henry Yuen (arXiv:2009.12982).

theorems.theorem_title: Source Role Register Final Point Consistency

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalConclusion_ofRoleRegisterScalarBoundary
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
    (eps : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hpass : strategy.PassesLowIndividualDegreeTest eps)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k)
    (hk0 : 0 < k)
    (hsmall : ¬ 1 ≤ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalError params k eps) :
    ∃ G_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA,
      ∃ G_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB,
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementA)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_B.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_A.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementB)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalError params k eps) := by sorry

# Main-formal soundness theorem

This module contains the corrected two-space final theorem for
`thm:main-formal`.  The theorem starts from a general projective strategy
`ProjStrat params ιA ιB`, applies the heterogeneous role-register route, and
absorbs the explicit intermediate errors into the final parameter
`mainFormalError`.

The public theorem uses the confirmed large-`k` correction `k ≥ 400 m d` and
the nonzero sampling condition `0 < k`.  These are documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/issue-906-main-formal-k-bound.tex` and
`docs/paper-gaps/issue-422-main-formal-zero-k-boundary.tex`.

## References

* Paper: `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex`,
  `thm:main-formal` at line 180; its proof is in
  `references/ldt-paper/inductive_step.tex` (lines 26–236).
* Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapter/ch02_test.tex`,
  `\label{thm:main-formal}`.
-/

theorems.theorem_title: Main Formal Conclusion Of Role Register Scalar Boundary

theorems.formal_statement:
theorem LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormal
    (params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters)
    [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (strategy : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
    (eps : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)
    (hpass : strategy.lowIndividualDegreeFailureProbability ≤ eps)
    (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k)
    (hk0 : 0 < k) :
    ∃ G_A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιA,
      ∃ G_B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params) ιB,
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementA)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_B.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point params))
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_A.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementB)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ConsRel strategy.state (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas)
            (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalError params k eps) := by sorry
